# Identifiers that sanitized fixtures are allowed to use in a social URL.
#
# The `no-live-accounts` check exists to stop a real account reaching apps/ or packages/.
# It cannot tell a real permalink from a fixture by looking at the URL alone, so the
# vocabulary is enumerated instead: adding a fixture id means adding it here, which is the
# friction that makes someone look at whether it is really synthetic.
#
# Empty since 2026-09-28. The Instagram, Threads and LinkedIn readers and every fixture
# that exercised them were removed (docs/DECISIONS.md), so no social URL has a reason to
# appear in the code at all — and any that does now fails the check.
